_about: Victor Duruy (1811-1894), French historian, in the illustrated English editions edited by J. P. Mahaffy: A History of Greece and of the Greek People (1892; 4 vols. in 8 sections; the translator is not named in these scans) and History of Rome and of the Roman People (tr. W. J. Clarke and M. M. Ripley, 1883-85; 8 vols., vol. IV in two sections, of which section II is missing: see _excluded). Each section identified from its title page. His histories of France and of the world are out of lane B's scope.
